description: Per-product policy that applies to every film for a product, whichever job folder or brand file it is made from. Shared code names no product; a product that needs a rule gets an entry here. A brand file may add to these but cannot switch them off. Add a product by adding an entry; a product with no entry gets the defaults.

abacare.note: Health-sensitive: films show synthetic data only and say so. Written brand is "ABACare AI"; pronunciation belongs to the product's lexicon, not here.
